title: Co2In: a Bi-level Memory Incremental Learning Framework with Knowledge Encoding, Consolidation, and Integration
abstract: arXiv:2610.21804v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Incremental learning (IL) aims to continually acquire new knowledge (plasticity) while retaining previously learned information (stability). However, striking a balance between plasticity and stability remains a significant challenge for intelligent systems. The human brain achieves exceptional balance, owing to various memory units that collaboratively encode and store information. Inspired by human memory mechanisms, this paper introduces an IL framework with knowledge enCoding, Consolidation, and Integration (Co2In). Co2In is designed as a bi-level memory architecture: a working memory for adaptive knowledge acquisition and a long-term memory dedicated to the persistent retention of information. The two memory modules work cooperatively during IL. The working memory first learns from new data to encode knowledge into parameters. translated_title: Co2In：一种具有知识编码、巩固与集成的双层记忆增量学习框架
translated_abstract: 增量学习旨在持续获取新知识（可塑性），同时保留先前学习的信息（稳定性）。然而，如何在可塑性与稳定性之间取得平衡仍然是智能系统面临的重大挑战。人类大脑由于多种记忆单元协同编码和存储信息，能够实现出色的平衡。受人类记忆机制启发，本文提出了一种具有知识编码、巩固与集成功能的增量学习框架。Co2In 被设计为双层记忆架构：一个用于自适应知识获取的工作记忆，和一个专门用于信息持久保留的长期记忆。这两个记忆模块在增量学习过程中协同工作。工作记忆首先从新数据中学习，将知识编码到参数中。随后，Co2In 执行巩固过程，以识别所学参数中的潜在模式……
tldr: 受人类记忆机制启发，Co2In 提出了一种由工作记忆和长期记忆构成的双层记忆增量学习框架，通过知识编码、巩固与集成机制在可塑性与稳定性之间实现平衡。
en_tdlr: Inspired by human memory mechanisms, Co2In proposes a bi-level memory incremental learning framework with working and long-term memory that balances plasticity and stability through knowledge encoding, consolidation, and integration.
